mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate below 5.0% signals tightening labor market conditions, which increases wage pressures and corporate input costs, leading to reduced profit margins and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 5.0%, or the average 20-day return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 0.25% over a 3-month window signals the start of a monetary tightening cycle, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in residential construction permits (HOUST) and personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals strong underlying demand growth, which boosts corporate revenues and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05 in interaction regression).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 105.0 for two consecutive months indicates weakening supply-side activity, which reduces corporate output and signals economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rebound in real personal consumption (RSAFS) following a 3-month decline signals a recovery in consumer demand, which increases corporate sales and earnings expectations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases > 0.5% MoM after 3 consecutive monthly declines
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the average return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the CPI (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% year-over-year, combined with a stable or rising federal funds rate, signals persistent inflationary pressures that trigger central bank hawkishness, leading to higher discount rates and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal fails to produce negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term is not significant (p > 0.05 in regression model).

mechanism_narrative: A rapid increase in non-farm payroll growth (PAYEMS) above 200k per month, combined with a declining unemployment rate, signals a labor market overheating, which increases wage pressures and inflation expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS > 200k and UNRATE declines > 0.2pp in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP (GDPC1) above 2.0% annualized, combined with rising residential construction (HOUST), indicates strong aggregate demand momentum, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05 in regression model).
